title: I'm building a real-time clothing design and simulation tool for the web
author: obraiadev
selftext:
I've recently been working on another project where I wanted to have more realistic cloth and hair simulations. I couldn't find many good solutions that could run efficiently in the browser, so I decided to try building my own.

That eventually led me to the need for a way to create the clothes themselves, so I'm now working on this application, which will allow users to design, simulate, and export garments.

I'm currently developing and testing everything on a Mac mini M4.

I think this could potentially be useful to other people as well, so I'd love to hear your thoughts on what features would be important for game development workflows.

I'm also hoping to monetize the application in some way down the road, while still keeping a free version available for people to use.

I'll also need a way to create physics-based hair for my other project, so I'm planning to build a separate tool for that in the future as well.

Just for context, the project is inspired by tools like Marvelous Designer and CLO3D.
